comment: The suites scripts/db-conformance.mjs runs against a real database.
A part's named invariant suite goes in `invariant`; the conformance suites
its change affects go in `conformance`. Both are paths from the repository
root. The runner fails when a named suite is missing, when any test in one
of them is skipped, and when a run ends with zero tests having executed.
Filled from the L1-TENANCY and L2-AUTHORITY handbacks: the pooled crossover,
the prefix harness and L2's identity, delegation, comment, preset-plan and
settings suites are the invariants; the first three conformance suites are the
catalogue, wrapper and runtime-statement proofs. statement-log.test.ts is
a pure unit suite and must not be named (it moves the database counter by 0).
L3-SURFACE adds the surface-operations suite (task.comment, preset.plan, settings, audited reads, D06); L4-RUNTIME adds the gate and lease suites (G01-G04, G06, G07, W01-W06, I07).
L2-FIX adds the comment-type upgrade, the login-kind race and the preset family suites.

L3-PART-B adds the task-runtime suite (propose/decide through the envelope, replay, the G03 recorded refusal, the runtime-refusal rollback, the proposal projection) and the agent-path suite (I12, I07: the pre-pickup pair, the one-task ceiling, the decision exclusion, the handback settlement, the agent-actor audit). runtime-codes.test.ts is a pure unit suite and must not be named.

L3-PART-B-2 adds the task-runtime-routes suite (the five routes and both prefixes over HTTP, the retained-report refusal, the in-process restart), the cli-reach suite (every declaration through the generated client) and the surface-reads suite (settings.read, session.capabilities, audited reads with a null subject, D06 on the read half); L4-RUNTIME-FIX's handback-propose-decide-invariants suite (R1-R10 regressions on a real database) is named with it. handback-expenditure.test.ts is a pure unit suite and must not be named.
L4-RUNTIME-FIX-2 adds the classifier-race suite (R1's executed two-classifier race) and the decision-abort suite (R2's forced post-write reservation refusal).
See docs/agents/database-conformance.md.

T4a names fixture-shape as an invariant (fixture_shape: the generator seeds an empty database through the real commands to SPEC 10.1's shape at a small scale, two businesses with their own people and clients and nothing shared, and refuses a database it already seeded; its run-events case is red until T2a is on the base).
SPINE-UPGRADE adds the visibility-upgrade suite (SURFACE-R-1: an installed spine reconciles title and state to the I09 shared class, nothing else moves, a second install writes nothing).

BOUNDARY-FIXES adds the four boundary suites (root rulings 1, 3, 4 and 5 and I14-SEAM U1: installed system-field keys at the top level, read targets and the task.board operand, the non-object-body admission refusal, effective-grant capabilities).

L5-PROOFS adds four acceptance suites (the generated exported-surface inventory, the six-role nine-case matrix, the protected set on three surfaces, the four-state predicate/RLS mutation proof); each runs in process against the real application. restart-and-expiry.test.ts is NOT named: its container-restart case is a guarded skip (L5_RESTART_CONTAINER_NAME, or the older L5_RESTART_CONTAINER=1) and the runner refuses a skipped test, so the coordinator runs that leg explicitly with the flag as its own step. world.ts, cast.ts, restart-harness.ts and role-case-*.ts are harnesses, not suites.

L3-PART-B-3 adds the settings-revision-routes suite (the two settings commands and settings.read by revision over in-process Hono), the envelope-faults suite (the omitted operationId and the two task.propose shapes over in-process Hono) and the settings-revision suite (the same three writes through executeCommand). handback-successor.test.ts is a pure unit suite and must not be named.

RUNTIME-LIFECYCLE adds the five lifecycle suites (cancellation closes delegation and run, stale-version handback refused with retained report, proposal/handback lock order, cancel race, authority-loss classification) and control-scope (cancel/restart authorised on their own target); W-SCHEDULES adds the W01 before/after-commit, W03 handback-versus-proposal, W05 competing-reservation and eight-hour heartbeat schedules through the real command entry.

PERSON-WORK adds person-work-http (EX-01 person pickup, renewal and handback on the person route, wrong-owner and lost-rights refusals) and person-work-schedules (grant.revoke against pickup, R5 fresh replacement, three competing claimants, an agent on a person's lease of its own task).

AUTHORITY-LOSS adds authority-loss-person-lease (grant.revoke classifies a person's own lease, write as work authority, the run back to planned, revoke responses listing classified holds, replay exactly once) and gate-reason-lineage (task.propose and task.restart answer a foreign and a fabricated lineage id byte-identically, audited at home).

PICKUP-REPLAY adds pickup-replay-lost-response (a lost pickup response replayed with the same derived credential and handles under current rights, lease and approval binding, no plaintext token or key bytes stored) and pickup-replay-keys (fixed HMAC encoding, keyring parsing and provisioning, rotation with retained read keys, closed failure on a missing key or corrupt metadata, legacy rows kept legacy).

DECISION-V3 names verified-decisions (the chain, payload and key checks on the proposal read) and decision-v3 (columns bound to the signed payload on v1, v2 and v3 with the unkeyed chain recomputed: a fabricated signer, a transplanted approval, every v3 field and link, the per-format signedFields label, and the pinned v3 bytes).

OWN-LEASE-SCOPE adds own-lease-record-scope (task.pickup, task.heartbeat and task.handback authorised on the task their reservation or lease belongs to: a record-scoped writer works their own lease, the sibling task and a fabricated id answer byte-identically, the strand case renews and hands back).

CLI-ENTRY adds cli-process (the runnable command line as separate OS processes against the real apps/api/server.ts on a free port: the person journey with revisions checked in the database, board and people reads, SCOPE_NOT_GRANTED, another business, an unknown verb with no request, the agent queue/pickup/heartbeat/handback with the saved delegation credential, a bare agent call, login's password grant, and the package script). cli-delegation-replay (Sol 6 SURFACE-1: a replayed handback of lease A, sent with A's credential from the environment, leaves lease B's saved credential in the file, and it still authorises B's heartbeat and handback) runs on the same harness. cli-process-harness.ts is a harness, not a suite; mounted-cli.test.ts stays unnamed because it needs SURFACE_API_PORT.

Also named: statement-capture-full, the fourth conformance suite (T04 and M03 over every operation); restricted-calls and restricted-calls-prefixes (I06 and M02 at the full schema and at every prefix, on seeded rows); production-lookup (I14 on the shipped lockTask, mutated on a disposable source copy); operand-refusals, capabilities-shape, unproduced-reach, gate-expiry, decision-integrity-read, controls-revoke, controls-work, web-reads, expiry-bound and the two external-party suites (R4); gate-negatives, model-negatives and gate-not-found; identifier-negatives (foreign, fabricated and same-business refusals compared by status and raw response bytes) and audit-per-operation (I13 and I08, and a non-object body recorded as one authentication_attempts row with no audit_events row, on both prefixes); authority-loss-narrowed, runtime-residuals and lease-held-reach.

DB-PROOF-GAPS-B adds l6-schedules (W02 b same-operationId pickup retry in flight, W04 pickup x task.cancel both orders and pickup x expired-lease replacement, each on two backends with observed parking), l6-cases (G04 superseded hold not claimable, G05 rulings 3 and 4, W05 BUDGET_UNAVAILABLE), restart-expiry-bound (task.restart at and one over seven days through the route) and heartbeat-bound (W02 c, the heartbeat maximum and one over).

Not named: tests/api/server-onerror.test.ts and tests/cli/mounted-cli.test.ts skip every case unless SURFACE_API_PORT names a spare loopback port for the real server they spawn, and the runner refuses a skip, so each runs as its own step with the port set.

G3-CASES adds grant-chain (a two-level manager chain through the grant writer: GRANT_WIDENS, GRANT_DEEPENS, and grant.revoke on the root biting the grandchild's next call beside a live sibling chain), agent-bare-handback-replay (a credential-free task.handback replay refused DELEGATION_EXCLUDES_OPERATION with nothing of the receipt and no state change) and decision-never-delegated (delegations_never_decide and the not-null decided_by_person_id, as the application role).

L3-RETENTION adds purge-retention (task.purge reads each business's retention_window_days inside its own transaction: two businesses with different windows and trash an hour either side, evidence untouched, a caller olderThanDays of any value refused COMMAND_BODY_INVALID with no mutation and one refused audit row, replay of an applied purge, a window of zero purging one business's trash only).

ID-OPERANDS adds id-operand-shape (a malformed id, "" and "not-a-uuid", against a fabricated uuid for every id operand on both prefixes: agent task.pickup, task.heartbeat and task.handback answer the fabricated refusal byte for byte instead of the uuid fault, person task.pickup, task.heartbeat and task.handback in the operation's own code, one refused audit row and no state change for each form, a numeric agent reservationId, and a valid pickup as the positive control).

PROOF-CLOSURE names d06-generated (D06 on the API, CLI and web person surfaces, every cell between a succeeding positive control and a succeeding clean retry, the person's own pickup, renewal and handback included) and d06-agent (D06 on the agent route).

AGENT-BOUNDARY adds agent-capabilities-intersection (agent session.capabilities reports the current intersection of purpose and the delegating person's effective grants: write absent once its grant expires, DELEGATION_NARROWED when nothing is held, and a replay under another delegation's credential never releases the first scope) and historical-handback-intake (a superseded or expired agent's new handback keeps one retained handback_reports row and one refused audit row and still answers DELEGATION_NOT_LIVE; wrong lease, fence or credential retain nothing; settled replay stays the replay), and names the existing capabilities-contract and agent-system-fields suites.

DB-PROOF-GAPS-A adds wrapper-mutation (T04 a and b: database.ts:105 made session-wide and moved before begin on a source copy, each red on the capture shape of real operations beside the unmutated copy; T04 c: the DECISION_INTEGRITY read captured as begin, local setting, work, rollback; T05: the session-wide mutant red at pooled-crossover's :168 and :206 reads, green on the restored wrapper), decision-signature-only (G02 a: only gate_decisions.signature altered, with and without the unkeyed chain recomputed, faults DECISION_INTEGRITY; restored, it reads) and decision-seq-race (G02 b: two approvals with room, parked on the chain lock on two backends, land at consecutive seq each linked to the row before).

RECOVERY-ENTRY adds recovery-entry (TC84/92 through the real apps/api/server.ts process with RECOVERY_BUSINESS_KEYS: an eligible recorded transition classified once before readiness, a second start subtracting nothing, an injected pre-commit fault rolled back with exit 1 and completed on the next start, claimable and unfenced-live holds untouched and a marked hold kept whole, only the configured business changed, two racing starts releasing each hold once).

AGENT-BOUNDARY-2 adds agent-pickup-payload (W02 a: person and agent pickup answers field by field against their rows, and the handbackShape derived from task.handback), and extends historical-handback-intake to a narrowed agent (DELEGATION_NARROWED keeps one retained report) with second-agent, cross-business, forged, lease, fence, replay and rollback controls on both paths.

ACCEPTANCE-ROWS names i10-inflight (I10: a read admitted and held open in its transaction while grant.revoke commits, then refused on the next call) and board-not-found (task.board on a foreign, fabricated or malformed board refused, never an empty success), the two suites L6 section 9 item 13 left unnamed for this lane; role-case-matrix now carries a named (c)/(d) row for all 35 operations and I07 on one live gate, and identifier-negatives the SC2 audit (9/9 at home, none in bravo). It adds identifier-timing (I04: 26 identifier-bearing operations, 30 alternating foreign/fabricated pairs after 5 discarded, Mann-Whitney |z| <= 3.29 or a median bound of max(2 ms, 20 percent), and a 15 ms injected delay flagged). cd-alternatives.ts is a harness, not a suite.

RETRY-BOUNDS adds retry-bounds (the terminal side of both bounded retries: task.cancel losing its discovery on both attempts, two command transactions and one failed-audit transaction; an agent pickup losing operations_identity_key on both attempts, staged because no schedule reaches it, two transactions and no audit event; grant.revoke taking its grant row before any runtime lock, with the waiters observed while a pickup is parked).

SOL-RUNTIME-FIX adds cap-exact-and-post-lock-clock (Sol 6 RUNTIME-1 to 3 through the command entry: a USD version under an AUD cap refused CAP_BINDING_MISMATCH with nothing moved; a cap of 2^53 + 1 filled exactly and one more unit refused BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, totals read as SQL text; a decide parked on its gate and a heartbeat parked on its lease past the deadline refused GATE_EXPIRED and LEASE_EXPIRED with no decision and no changed lease or delegation expiry).

SOL-AUTHORITY-FIX adds non-member-grants (R4 against provisioned record-scoped comment and write grants: alone they are no standing, beside a read share they write no team note and no update, the client audience only on a held comment grant, the shared projection unchanged) and agent-operation-id (a number, array, null or absent agent operationId is OPERATION_ID_REQUIRED with no register row; the string registers), and extends historical-handback-intake with actualMinor 1 on the narrowed, retired and grant-expired paths (ACTUAL_EXPENDITURE_UNSUPPORTED, nothing retained).

RETRY-GAPS adds retry-gaps (task.propose meeting a pickup of the superseded hold and grant.revoke meeting a handback of a dependent lease, each forced between discovery and locks, answer the first request after one retry; propose losing twice answers AffectedSetChanged after two attempts with nothing committed; the unreachable handback binding recheck is proved typed and bounded by a rewritten read).

COMMAND-CATALOGUE adds stray-identifiers (a stray identifier on task.heartbeat, task.cancel, task.restart, grant.revoke and delegation.revoke is refused COMMAND_BODY_INVALID with nothing written; architecture observation 2).

THERMO-RUNTIME adds recovery-replay-pin (replay's eligible set unchanged when discovery is shared) and pickup-refusal-order (the ruled O6 order: approval refused before any replacement write), both against a real database.

SOL6-RUNTIME-FIX-2 adds lease-expiry-post-lock-clock (Sol 6 RUNTIME-1 at 158d6de through the command entry: a handback parked on the cap past its lease expiry refused LEASE_EXPIRED, its report retained, lease, hold, envelope, gates and versions unchanged; a person pickup parked on the cap past the bound lease's expiry fences it, classifies the old hold lease_expired_and_fenced and opens exactly one fresh hold, its lease running from the post-lock instant); and successor-bounds-exact (Sol 6 RUNTIME-2: a cap of 2^54 + 3 with 2^54 + 1 committed through valid holds, a successor ceiling of 4 refused SUCCESSOR_OUT_OF_BOUNDS with no report, no successor and nothing moved, and a ceiling of 2 accepted with a pending successor gate).

SOL6-AUTHORITY-FIX-2 adds person-replay-current-rights (a person replay of a stored success answers current authority: pickup after the only covering write grant is revoked is SCOPE_NOT_GRANTED with no receipt, no second lease and the register row unchanged; a pickup whose lease was handed back is LEASE_EXPIRED; task.create after revocation is refused; live rights replay as stored; Sol 6 AUTHORITY-1).

SOL6-AUTHORITY-FIX-2 adds agent-operand-types (on the agent prefix an array reservationId is COMMAND_BODY_INVALID with no lease, a string fence or array outcome is FIELD_VALUE_INVALID with the lease live and no report, and after the person's write grant lapses an array outcome retains nothing; string ids, numeric fences and string outcomes still claim, settle and retain; Sol 6 AUTHORITY-2), and sends agent-person-wording's pickup and handback rows the same full body on both entries.

SOL6-AUTHORITY-FIX-2 adds agent-read-targets (on the agent prefix a stray recordId on task.queue or session.capabilities and a stray board on task.read is COMMAND_BODY_INVALID naming the field, one body for own, foreign and fabricated ids, one refused audit event per call, before the delegation is read and in the person prefix bytes; the reads without it answer 200; Sol 6 AUTHORITY-3).

THERMO-FIX-AGENT adds agent-record-shape (THERMO-RECHECK-2 NNA1: on the agent prefix a recordId that is present and not a string, an array, a nested array, an object, a number, a boolean or null naming a sibling task, is refused before any authority in the person prefix bytes, NOT_FOUND on task.comment and FIELD_VALUE_INVALID on task.read, with one refused audit row, no state change and no comment on the sibling; the agent's own task and a string sibling are the controls).

THERMO-FIX-AGENT adds pickup-receipt-binding (THERMO-RECHECK-2 NNA2: the one pickup-replay binding step both entries take, on a real stored agent receipt: its holder under its own delegation gets the credential columns; no delegation, another agent's delegation or another holder is LEASE_NOT_OWNED).

SOL6-RUNTIME-FIX-2 adds lease-expiry-post-lock-clock (Sol 6 RUNTIME-1 at 158d6de through the command entry: a handback parked on the cap past its lease expiry refused LEASE_EXPIRED, its report retained, lease, hold, envelope, gates and versions unchanged; a person pickup parked on the cap past the bound lease's expiry fences it, classifies the old hold lease_expired_and_fenced and opens exactly one fresh hold, its lease running from the post-lock instant; the same agent's replacement parked the same way settles its expired delegation instead of refusing DELEGATION_ALREADY_LIVE); and successor-bounds-exact (Sol 6 RUNTIME-2: a cap of 2^54 + 3 with 2^54 + 1 committed through valid holds, a successor ceiling of 4 refused SUCCESSOR_OUT_OF_BOUNDS with no report, no successor and nothing moved, and a ceiling of 2 accepted with a pending successor gate); its continuation adds handback-envelope-totals (thermo NB5: a marked attempt's handback answers the quarantined 1500 held from the envelope row, not a 0 fallback).

PROTECTED-MIGRATIONS adds cap-storage-backstop (migrations 0024 and 0025 through the application role, on a fresh database and on one seeded at 0023 then upgraded: a USD envelope under an AUD cap, a cap currency change beneath an envelope and an envelope moved to another currency or cap refused by task_envelopes_cap_currency_fkey; a cap filled to exactly its ceiling, then one unit more on hold, on actual, by insert, by lowering the limit and by the second of two open transactions that each fit alone refused budget_caps_ceiling at commit; seeded rows unchanged by the upgrade; a 0023 database holding a mismatched or over-ceiling row stops before the rule with the row untouched).

CAP-RR extends cap-storage-backstop (Sol 6 SURFACE-R-2: two application-role transactions whose snapshots both saw room under one cap, each raise fitting alone, together over it; at read committed the second is refused budget_caps_ceiling, at repeatable read and serializable it is refused serialization_failure, and the committed total stays within the cap on fresh and upgraded databases).

OWNER-RULINGS-FIX adds comment-rulings (Nathan's first-slice rulings over HTTP: a delegated agent's client-audience comment refused AUDIENCE_NOT_PERMITTED 422 on the agent prefix and AUTH_NO_MEMBERSHIP 403 on the person prefix, its internal note written, nothing else written; a comment on a trashed task refused NOT_FOUND 404 on both entries in the bytes of an identifier nothing carries, no comment written) and moves external-party to the I09 ruling (a shared task shows its client the title and the state's label).

ARCH-4 adds rediscovery-pin (the statement sequence from the first unlocked discovery to the end of the recheck at propose, cancel, delegation.revoke, grant.revoke and the startup replay, taken before those sites moved onto one rediscovery module; propose's window gains its held-set recheck with O3), and o3-held-recheck (thermo O3: task.propose meeting an approval of the version it supersedes, forced between discovery and locks, and a rejection meeting a hold revived by a test write in the same window, each answer the first request after one AffectedSetChanged retry with the hold classified under the right cause and nothing written by the lost attempt).

THERMO-FIX-RUNTIME adds successor-bounds-edge (thermo NB1 at 9d2dbde through the command entry: with 2 units of cap room, a successor ceiling of 3 and a successor in USD under an AUD cap are each refused SUCCESSOR_OUT_OF_BOUNDS in their exact bytes with no report retained and nothing moved, and a ceiling of exactly 2 is accepted).

Not named, because each skips without a variable the runner does not set and the runner refuses a skip: restart-http.test.ts (W06 over HTTP, needs L5_RESTART_CONTAINER_NAME and L5_RESTART_API_PORT, run beside restart-and-expiry by pnpm verify:restart) and pickup-replay-restart.test.ts (a lost pickup across an API and Postgres restart, needs PICKUP_REPLAY_API_PORT and PICKUP_REPLAY_PG_CONTAINER) and runtime-proofs.test.tsx (T3d2's F1 and F2, real API and worker processes killed with SIGKILL, needs L5_RUNTIME_PROOFS and L5_RESTART_API_PORT, run on its own Postgres by pnpm verify:runtime-proofs) and drop-proofs.test.ts (T3e1's drops from real worker processes, run beside it). Not named because they are pure unit suites that import a harness module reaching fresh-database.ts but open no database: restart-declared.test.ts (restart-harness refusals), cli-answers.test.ts and cli-wire.test.ts (the real CLI against an HTTP stand-in, through cli-process-harness), and global-setup.test.ts (besideUrl only).

FR1-DBTEST (final review R1 #49) names the 23 database-bound suites that no required context ran: tests/api/{admission-enumeration,agent-operation-id,surface-operations}, tests/commands/{agent-operands,agent-operation-order,agent-replay-auth,audit-chain,command-shape,command-surface,concurrency,create-authority,local-slice,lost-update,task-fields,task-lifecycle,task-trash-commands}, tests/identity/{identifier-resolution,login-resolution}, tests/records/{records-integrity,slot-law} and tests/tasks/{task-model,task-spine,task-trash}. The tests/api and tests/commands files named agent-operation-id and surface-operations are different suites, and both copies are named. It adds storage-triggers (#64: the 0010 proposal_versions and 0014 attempts triggers, each branch broken on purpose as the application role and as the owner, with the permitted writes as the control) and named-suite-manifest, the guard that fails when a suite reaching fresh-database.ts is neither named nor listed here as unnamed; that guard is a pure unit suite and must not be named.

FR1-DBTEST-CONT names the merged FR1 lanes' database-bound suites: comment-on-trashed-task and unstorable-command-bodies (FR1-JSONB), shared-business-key (FR1-API-SIGN), trash-purge-cancel-scope (FR1-TRASH), placement-operands and placement-locks-and-reach (FR1-PLACE) and decide-cancel-revoke-races (FR1-RUNTIME). Not named: operation-id-login-and-stdout.test.ts is a pure unit suite (it moves the counter by 0 and its terminal case skips without a terminal). decision-signature-read.test.ts is left out for now, because it fails at the integration head 83accc6: its fixture decides with an object note, which FR1-RUNTIME's #53 fix refuses FIELD_VALUE_INVALID (packages/core-runtime/src/decide.ts:74-75). It is named once its owner lane reconciles the two.

FR1-DBTEST-CONT adds seed-revoke-live-lease (#60: scripts/local-seed.mjs run as its own process on a fresh database refuses to revoke a grant that is the work authority for a live lease, naming the grant and what to do instead, and leaves the grant and the lease as they were).

FR1-DBTEST-CONT-2 names agent-prefix-identity-edges, delegation-widens and merge-cycle (FR1-AGENT), owning-operation-fields (FR1-PLACE-CONT), unstorable-values-direct-callers (FR1-JSONB-CONT) and trashed-task-work-and-notes (FR1-RUNTIME-CONT), and now decision-signature-read: FR1-RUNTIME-CONT-2 rebuilt its fixture as a signed stored row, so the unnamed reason recorded above no longer holds.

FR1-DBTEST-CONT-3 names storage-backstop-migrations as an invariant (FR1-MIGRATIONS: the storage backstops of 0026 to 0028, #63 no actual reservation in the first head, #24 a business key unique across businesses, #55 no delete on identity history, on fresh and upgraded databases), and settings-unstorable-values and agent-settle-stored-form (FR1-JSONB continuations 2 and 3).

FR2-DBTEST names cap-ceiling-fails-closed as an invariant (migration 0029, R2-RUNTIME-6 = R2-AUTHORITY-20: an envelope inserted, a hold raised or a limit lowered by the application role, then app.business_id cleared or switched to another business before commit, is refused budget_caps_ceiling past the ceiling and within it, because a hidden cap is not room; the same writes under a steady setting commit within the ceiling and are refused past it; on a fresh database and on one seeded at 0028 then upgraded, with the seeded rows unchanged).

FR2-DBTEST-CONT names the round-2 lanes' database-bound suites. Invariant: temporary-tables (FR2-API, R2-AUTHORITY-61: the application role holds no TEMPORARY, and default deny notices a grant of it). Conformance: trash-restore-purge (FR2-TRASH: restore takes the parent lock, purge of comments, grants, recheck and ids, the long window), share-revoke-on-trashed-task (FR2-TRASH-CONT: revokeShare on a trashed task, with refusal controls), party-capability-reads (FR2-API: R4 session.capabilities offers only usable pairs, and person.list), settings-revision-type (FR2-API: a non-integer settings expectedRevision is refused 422 FIELD_VALUE_INVALID), agent-deactivation (FR2-API: the agent door refuses a deactivated actor or mapping), propose-operands-and-authority and restart-other-lineage (FR2-PROPOSE and its continuation: the propose refusals, and a restart naming a sibling task's lineage answered by the task guard without either id), placement-destination-and-rank (FR2-PLACE: placement), decide-cancel-lifecycle-under-lock, grants-at-locked-instant and decision-evidence-binding (FR2-RUNTIME and its continuation; the continuation reaches the database through the controls fixture), and unstorable-operands and external-comment-from-own-reads (FR2-JSONB). Not named: delegation-keyring-file, credential-save-and-canonical-body, timestamptz-values and api-comment-and-seed-docs are unit suites, and the three tests/surfaces final-r2 suites are jsdom only; none reaches fresh-database.ts.
FR2-DBTEST-CONT-2 names placement-lock-order as a conformance suite (FR2-PLACE continuation: placement lock order, move rank, rank neighbour case).

FR2-DBTEST-0030 names gate-pack-binding as an invariant (migration 0030, FR2-P2: as the application role, a decided gate pointed at another version's pack, a decided gate moved onto a superseded version with its own run, step and pack, and a gate inserted naming another version's pack are refused gates_pack_in_same_version or gates_version_fixed_once_decided with nothing moved; the runtime's propose, approve, reject and request-changes-then-approve still commit; on a fresh database and on one seeded at 0029 then upgraded, with the seeded rows unchanged; a 0029 database holding any of the three stops before 0030 with its rows untouched). decision-evidence-binding case (c) now asserts that storage refusal and proves the read check with the owner's move.

FR2-DBTEST-0031 names upgrade-guards as an invariant (migration 0031, FR2-P3, SOL-R3-2 and SOL-R3-1 on databases built at 0028 and migrated: TEMPORARY held at 0028 by PUBLIC, the application group or the application login is refused to the login after the upgrade; a cap committed past its ceiling through the old 0025 hole, with the setting cleared or switched, refuses the upgrade with rows unchanged and 0031 not recorded; a valid 0028 database and a fresh one migrate cleanly).

FR2-DBTEST-CONT-3 names the round-3 lanes' database-bound suites, all as conformance (behavioural fixes, as round 2's were): propose-open-envelope-and-lineage (FR3-PROPOSE: SOL-R3-3 envelope room at propose, with controls; R3-AUTHORITY-20 lineage-on-task before pricing; R3-AUTHORITY-19 upper-case lineageId; R2-RUNTIME-26 (b) restart against the business cap; it reaches fresh-database.ts through openSchedules), placement-case-and-restore (FR3-PLACE: a restored subtask takes its live parent's board; a trash through an ancestor takes a child created or restored meanwhile; one sibling lock per id however it is cased; task.move to its own board in upper case), decide-operands-and-replay-lock (FR3-DECIDE: a non-string versionId, parentId, board or boardSection refused by name at the typed-identifier door rather than 503, and the replayed reparent's authority re-judgement, R3-AUTHORITY-6 = R3-RUNTIME-7 = R3-SURFACE-9, R2-AUTHORITY-33, R1-RUNTIME-53, R3-SURFACE-8, R3-THERMO-25) and seed-revoke-in-flight (FR3-DECIDE, R1-AUTHORITY-60: the seed takes the dropped grants for update first, so it waits for an in-flight pickup and sees its lease rather than revoking the grant under it).

FR3R-0030 names decided-gate-upgrade-race as an invariant (migration 0030, SOL-R3R-1: on a database seeded at 0029 through the runtime, the application role's move of a decided gate onto a superseded version with its own run, step and pack, made while 0030 is paused after its check block, waits for 0030 and is refused gates_version_fixed_once_decided with the gate on its decided version; the same move in flight when the upgrade starts makes the upgrade wait, then refuses the upgrade at 0029). R4-THERMO-4 adds two cases to gate-pack-binding, one per trigger guard: (d) a decided gate reset to pending and then moved, refused by the decision guard alone, and (e) a superseded gate with no decision moved, refused by the state guard alone.

FR5-0030 adds two cases to decided-gate-upgrade-race (SOL-R3R2-1): a real propose on a database at 0029, held between its evidence pack and its gate (a first version) or between superseding the old gate and its pack (a successor), while 0030 starts as the runner applies it. Both must commit, with 0030 recorded, its pack key validated and the gate on its own version's pack. Unedited, 0030 deadlocked with the first; locking evidence_packs before gates deadlocks with the second; 0030 now locks proposal_versions first.

FR6-RUNNER names migration-runner-guard as an invariant (the migration runner, owner ruling 2026-09-24: with a migration pending, a held application-login session or any other client backend on the database refuses the run, naming each by pid, login, application, address and start, with the ledger and schema unchanged; it applies once they close; an up-to-date database with the application connected passes; a session that connects inside a migration is caught by the check before its commit; db-migrate.mjs refuses and exits 2 with no bypass). The caller suites that seed through their own pools now close them first (EmptyDatabase.closeSessions), with assertions unchanged.

FR8-0031 adds a case to upgrade-guards: a member of the application group dropped by another session after 0031's role loop has read it, on a fixed schedule (the loop blocks on a row lock the dropping session holds until the drop commits), no longer fails the upgrade, and every surviving member still has TEMPORARY revoked.

CQ-14 adds owning-operation-constraints (product issue 54): the two 0009 checks on field_defs.owning_operation, field_defs_owning_operation_not_empty and field_defs_operation_names_are_operations, each refusing a bad row by name, with a valid list as the control. Its result is the evidence for S0-6's question 6 (the text[] domain change): 'refuses an empty list by field_defs_owning_operation_not_empty' and 'refuses a malformed operation name by field_defs_operation_names_are_operations' name both checks, and 'accepts a well-formed unknown operation name today: the check reads spelling, not existence' pins that the check reads spelling, not existence, until ops-astro#142 turns it into a refusal.

W0-T2a names run-progress-read as an invariant (run_progress_read: a pickup and a hand-back appear as ordered run_events through task.execution, per run, readable mid-run and identical on a second pool; refused pickups and hand-backs write their audit event and no run event; another business, an unseen or shared client, a person without the grant and a record grant elsewhere are each refused, never an empty graph).

T2c1 names t2c1-dispatch and t2c1-dispatch-migration as invariants (recheck_inside_dispatch: a grant revocation in flight is waited for under the dispatch's grant lock and then refused AUTHORITY_LOST with nothing marked; each effect-time fact moved in turn refuses with its own code; EFFECT_NOT_RECONCILABLE; another business's lease and step are neither changed nor waited on. Migration 0033 on a fresh database and on one seeded at 0032 through the runtime then upgraded: rows unchanged, the same constraints, the step and marker rules refused as the application role, the worker holding nothing on either table), and t2c1-dispatch-surfaces as conformance (task.dispatch through the command line and both HTTP prefixes against the served API: the mark, a replay by operation identity, and BUDGET_UNAVAILABLE on every surface).

REV114 names t2c1-rejected-decision-crash-seam (first filed as sol-t2c1-crash-decision) as conformance (Sol review 1 on #114, criterion 2: with the crash seam armed at reservation_committed, a rejected decision commits and answers without a reservation rather than parking). Not named: t2c1-dispatch-separation-coverage (first filed as sol-t2c1-separation) is a pure unit suite reading the surfaces test's source.

T2c2 names t2c2-effect as an invariant (effect_once_with_receipt: approve, dispatch, one team-only comment under the operation identity derived from the attempt, observe, and a receipt citing that decision, its version and the effect; a second pass replays every step and adds nothing; a staged intent is refused EFFECT_NOT_OBSERVED with no receipt; an effect before its dispatch is refused EFFECT_NOT_DISPATCHED; duplicate delivery and a lost response apply it once; observe refuses a non-holder, a foreign, unknown or fenced token and a released hold, audited, with no money moved; another business's receipt reads as a made-up one and a person outside the task's client is refused), and t2c2-worker as conformance (the worker proposes, a person approves, the worker applies it once through the agent routes, the person reads the receipt through the command line's client, and a second worker pass is idle).

T2d names t2d-settle and t2d-settle-migration as invariants (settles_at_observed: the hold settles to the priced observed cost with the difference released by amount, settling twice charges once, an unpriced or absent report reads as unpriced and moves no money; the receipt names the settled amount; a failure injected in the step, the reservation or the audit event rolls back all three; an expired lease settles money and moves no work; a cost above the hold is refused, audited with the observed amount and held as liability_unknown at the maximum; a failed attempt settles at its cost against the ceiling; hand-back still refuses actual spend; another business's envelopes never move, and the money line reaches only a reader with the task grant. Migration 0034 on a fresh database and on one seeded at 0033 then upgraded: rows unchanged, the same constraints, 0026 byte-identical and lifted, the settled-actual rules refused as the application role, the worker holding nothing). These are the budget tests the manifest names (product issue 14).

T2e names t2e-top-up as an invariant (top_up_is_a_persons: an agent under its delegation is refused DELEGATION_EXCLUDES_OPERATION and the same person tops up on their own credential; the four-eyes band is read from the business setting, 500 by default, off permitted, and a second approver above it is a different person holding billing:decide in that business; an ordinary top-up is the plan approver's when they hold budget permission, otherwise any holder's; no standing pre-authorisation; the cap is the hard ceiling; separations business to business, client to client and person to person; split for the per-file cap into t2e-top-up-races, the second approval against a revocation, a concurrent first approval and a late approver's grant under revocation, and t2e-top-up-clients, two external clients each sharing one task, crossing, plus task to task), and t2e-top-up-surfaces as conformance (budget.top_up through the command line, both HTTP prefixes and the in-process entries against the served API: the agent refused alike on every surface, the person applied on every surface).

W0-INTEG names t2d-late-effect-and-wrong-client (T2d's review proofs, first filed as sol-t2d-review) as an invariant beside t2d-settle: a concurrent failure leaves no late effect on the settled attempt, and a wrong-client effect identity never waits on that client's step. It opens a database and was unnamed at T2d's own head; main's named-suite manifest refuses that on the integration line.

W0-INTEG's group A lint commit (CQ-12 ratchet) splits four named suites by behaviour, each case unchanged, and names the new files in the same list as the file they came from: cq-2-start-up-keys (from cq-2), task-explicit-null (from task-lifecycle), t2d-settle-isolation (from t2d-settle) and pickup-version-binding (from agent-pickup-payload).

T2g names t2g-decide-parity as an invariant (journey_parity_cli, decision leg: request_changes through the command line as its own process records the same decision as the app's person route; another business's person and a member without the grant are refused the same code on both surfaces with the gate left pending; an agent's own login is refused the decision the person's credential then makes, isolation cases 5 and 9). T2g also names t2g-journey as an invariant (journey_parity_cli, whole journey: the worker proposes and applies, each person step runs once through the command line as its own process and once through the app route, and the two legs record the same facts: FOUR_EYES_REQUIRED for the assignee, GATE_PENDING on completing with the gate open, GATE_ALREADY_DECIDED on a second decision, an agent refused with its exact delegation in the audit and no decision written, the receipt naming the approval, and the run events; a command line refusing the receipt turns it red).

T2h names t2h-alerts, t2h-alerts-migration and t2h-alerts-surfaces as invariants (alert_on_transition: settling, failing, a cost above the hold, a hand-back that settles, fails or leaves a successor, and a cancellation each raise exactly one alert, shown by task.read and task.queue and the same through the API and the command line; pickup, dispatch, the effect, an unpriced observe, proposing and approving raise none; another business, a client of another task, the task's own client and a member with no grant see none. Migration 0036 on a fresh database and on one seeded at 0035 then upgraded: rows unchanged, the same catalogue, nothing added to the gate engine's tables, one alert per transition, update and delete refused as the application role, the worker holding nothing).

T3b names t3b-sweeper as an invariant (unknown_stays_unknown: driven by the declining reporter handed in at construction, a dispatched attempt whose lease runs out is held liability_unknown at its full maximum, and the sweep, the restart replay and every timer past every window leave it so; the sweep releases in full, by amount, a hold never marked whose lease ran out, never one awaiting pickup or under a live lease, races dispatch with one winner, holds a marked step unknown without asking the register, keeps quarantine for legacy rows, leaves a first-slice database unchanged or classified by name; the API pass runs each configured business in its own transaction; separations business to business, client to client and person to person). t3b-shipped-graph is a pure unit suite and is not named.

T3d1 names t3d1-reconcile as an invariant (reconcile_never_repeats: the pass's reconciliation phase asks the operation register about a step the sweep held unknown; presence proved settles once, by the book's amount, with the effect counter at 1; absence proved keeps the old hold for a person, fences the old identity and resumes a new attempt on its own hold and identity through T2c1's recheck; a woken worker's old-identity apply is refused and audited and its late observe moves no money; no answer leaves the step for a person; the pass replays recorded transitions and a duplicated wake-up does nothing; budget.record_outcome records one of three outcomes under billing:decide, replayed by operation identity, never an agent's; migration 0037; separations business to business, client to client and person to person).

T3d1 Fix 1 names t3d1-outcome-stops as an invariant (Sol review 1 on #146, criterion 2: a person's happened outcome stops the replacement the pass reserved, in the same transaction under the same locks: its hold released, its lease ended, its delegation revoked, never dispatched; a lost response replays with nothing moved; happened racing the replacement's dispatch on two backends has exactly one winner; a replacement that already dispatched refuses happened with nothing moved).

T3e1 names t3e1-drops as an invariant (drop_is_not_cancel: a worker's dropped hand-back naming provider_unavailable or connection_lost, and a lease that ran out on its own clock swept as worker_lost, each leave the attempt dropped with its own cause and fault (the provider's, the network's, ours), append dropped then reactivated to the run's progress so the next pickup continues from position 4, reserve the step again and raise one dropped alert; a person's cancellation at the same point is abandoned, never dropped, never reactivated, and replays by operation identity; a dispatched step that drops keeps its whole hold liability_unknown with the cause for the reconciliation pass; a worker naming worker_lost or no cause is refused with nothing written; a drop in one business leaves the other's rows byte-identical).

T3e2 names t3e2-outage as an invariant (one_report_per_outage: fifty runs dropped by one injected provider outage, ten hand-backs at a time, give exactly one open outage report naming the cause, its fault and window and all fifty runs, each marked reactivated, and zero dropped alerts; another cause is its own report and a drop after the window closes the old report and opens a new one; the same cause in two businesses gives each its own report and neither queue names the other's tasks; a client and a member with no grant see no outage).

T3c names t3c-write-off and t3c-write-off-isolation as invariants (write_off_needs_a_person: budget.write_off with no person, no amount or no written reason is refused and moves nothing; a person holding billing:decide closes the unknown hold at the reserved maximum, a lesser figure or nothing, and the money tables gain no row; above T2e's stored four-eyes band a different live holder names the same figure; a lost response replays by operation identity; absence proved resumes the work while the first hold stays unknown until written off, O6; two people at once, and a write-off racing a recorded outcome, have one winner; separations business to business, client to client, task to task and person to person; T3 no machine path: the runtime write-off has one caller), and t3c-write-off-surfaces as conformance (the agent under its delegation and a member without billing:decide refused alike on the command line, both HTTP prefixes and the in-process entries; the holder applied on each).

T3f names t3f-expired-lease, t3f-lease-edges and t3f-races as invariants (expired_lease_money_only: task.observe from an expired lease settles the priced cost, marks lease expired in the stored answer and moves no lease, run, task or delegation, while renewal, a second dispatch and a hand-back on it are refused LEASE_EXPIRED; a live lease's settlement is marked live; an expired lease settles only its own business's money and another business's lease is LEASE_NOT_OWNED; a successor against an exhausted parent cap is SUCCESSOR_OUT_OF_BOUNDS with nothing moved; a silent run keeps its live lease until expiry, then is fenced and held unknown; four approvals at once on one envelope with room for three, and four first approvals under a cap with room for three, through the HTTP route: exactly three each, BUDGET_UNAVAILABLE and BUDGET_EXHAUSTED once, totals exact), and t3f-two-workers as conformance (T3-N1: two OS processes running the shipped worker under their own delegations race one approved task on the served API: one lease, one effect, the loser idle or refused, and its identity refused LEASE_NOT_OWNED on the winner's lease; no credential printed).

W0-INTEG names t3e1-worker-steps (T3e1's answers lost at each worker step, from #154) as an invariant beside t3e1-drops: a provider call that may have acted keeps the whole hold unknown and reserves nothing until the pass proves the effect absent; a lost answer at dispatch or at the effect replays and the effect happens once; a lost drop hand-back is handed back again under its first identity. It opens a database and was unnamed at the chain head; main's named-suite manifest refuses that on the integration line.

T3a names t3a-revision-loop as an invariant (revision_loop_keeps_settled: after one settled attempt of 1800, two rounds of changes, the third refused CHANGE_ROUNDS_EXHAUSTED, a rejection never approved again and a restart, the settled amount stays 1800 on the old envelope, now closed, and the restarted lineage's approval opens a new envelope; red until T2d settles real spend. Migration 0040: a terminal lineage is neither updated nor deleted by any role and takes no new version. T3 decide authority: approve, reject, request changes, restart and cancel refused to a person without decide on the app, the API and the command line, to an agent under its delegation, and to a person whose decide grant is on another task, writing no decision, lineage, envelope or gate change; another business's gate and lineage are not found). Those authority cases are t3a-decide-authority, split from t3a-revision-loop under CQ-12's lines and named beside it.

T3a also names t3a-escalate (escalate at the bound: to a holder of decide at business scope, recording actor and recipient on the gate with no decision written, after which the approver's task-scoped decide is refused SCOPE_NOT_GRANTED and a business-scope decider decides; an approver outside the role or an unknown person as recipient fails closed with approve and reject still performable; refused before the bound TRANSITION_NOT_PERMITTED; replayed by operation identifier; refused to an agent and to a person without decide on the app, the API and the command line. PROPOSAL_SUPERSEDED for a decision on a superseded version and PROPOSAL_SCOPE_EXCEEDED for a revision past the envelope).

T4b1 names journey-twice as an invariant (journey_twice_same_facts: the propose, decide, apply, settle journey through the app's own operations client and again through one command-line process per call, against a served API process, leaves identical decision, receipt, reservation, attempt, run-event, audited-write and alert facts once identifiers, times and digests are normalised; a comparison with a pass missing or empty is refused as one-sided; bravo's person is refused each pass's task on the same surface, and no answer either pass was given carries bravo's canary task).

T4b2 names t4-worker-role as an invariant (T4 worker role, RN-04: catalogue, the worker role and a login in it hold no privilege on any table, view, sequence or function in the installation's schemas, security-definer ones included, and no CREATE or USAGE on ops, and PUBLIC may execute no function; the catalogue mutation, SELECT granted on reservations, is found while behaviour alone stays refused 42501; behaviour, a login in the worker role is refused 42501 on every table, sequence and callable function beside the application login reading the same tables; structure is tests/worker/worker-boundary.test.ts).

T4b2 names t4-no-notify as an invariant (RN-01: a whole journey through the application, create, propose, approve, pickup, dispatch, effect, observe, settle and receipt, leaves no NOTIFY and no pg_notify in the runtime statement log, whose capture holds the journey's decision, reservation and run-event writes; a pg_notify planted on the runtime pool is caught).

W0-INTEG names snapshot-clone-and-privileges (T4a's review proofs, first filed as sol-snapshot) as an invariant beside fixture-shape: a snapshot build completes and leaves a cloneable template, a clone works while a reader holds the template, and both clone paths deny temporary tables to the application role; and bundle (T4d's bundle_names_the_approval: the bundle's approved action is the decision row byte for byte, and the bundle scan finds no credential, canary or claim of acceptance) beside journey-twice. Not named: budgets-bundle-and-person-crossing.test.ts (T4's review proofs, first filed as sol-proof-t4-review) is a pure unit suite: it reaches world.ts only for a type, stubs fetch and opens no database, so it moves the counter by 0.
